# Vendored libraries

Served from this folder so the app makes no third-party requests.

| File | Library | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | pdf.js | 3.11.174 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174 |
| `xlsx.full.min.js` | SheetJS CE | 0.20.3 | cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3 |
| `fonts/*.ttf` | Geist, Geist Mono | v5 | Google Fonts (SIL OFL) |

Checksums: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.
